text:
anya: quick heads-up from the code-model bring-up this morning — int4 variant shows tokenization misalignments for mixed markdown+code prompts in deid-code-rag. We need a microgolden focusing on tokenizer edgecases + dedupe.

Tomas: can you share the failure modes / eval slices?

anya: short paste: long fenced blocks + inline backticks get split, identifiers split across tokens, and small diffs in punctuation. Not huge overall, but risky for our code consumers.

```
$ rbin eval --model code-onboard-1.1-int4 --dataset deid-code-rag --slices fenced_code,inline_code_blocks,identifier_preserve
Exact-token-preserve: 89.2% (-4.9% vs fp16)
Signature-exact: 91.0% (-3.3%)
Identifier-split-rate: 3.6% (+2.4%)
Latency p50: 238ms
```

nora: interesting. any quick ablates? swapped tokenizer v1->v2 locally?

anya: ran with legacy-bpe locally; identifier-split-rate improved ~1.0% but some cases persisted. So tokenizer+quant interaction likely.

Tomas: let's treat as a targeted quality regression. Microgolden proposal: 300 examples balanced across: 160 fenced multi-line blocks (short+long), 80 inline code with math/LaTeX, 60 adversarial spacing/backtick variants. 3 independent labelers per example.

anya: labeler checklist (ops copy):
1) run model output against the provided source snippet
2) mark exact_code_preserve yes/no
3) mark identifier_split yes/no and provide smallest evidence span
4) mark hallucination if model adds code/explanations not in source and add short note
5) severity 0-3

ops-bot: New ticket created: ML-6233 "code-onboard int4: tokenization/code-preserve regression". Labeling plan attached.

Tomas: sampling/dedupe plan? We must avoid heavy overlap with existing golden and the promptbank. Also include tokenizer version in provenance.

anya: plan: sample 1k candidates from recent RAG logs (30d window) -> compute byte-level & tokenizer-shingle (shingle_size=4) fuzzy dedupe -> filter out any md5_text present in golden index -> surface 450 candidates -> labelers confirm final 300. Provenance fields: source_ts, route, session_id, tokenizer_hash, md5_text, bpe_version.

labeler-bot: Labeling batch LB-10021 created for ML-6233. ETA first pass: 48 hrs.

nora: on the model side I'll run a small kernel+tokenizer grid: int4 with bpe-legacy vs bpe-v3, keep embeddings fp16 for one run, and test aten vs flash kernels. Example: 

```
rbin quant-sweep --model code-onboard-1.1 --bits 4 --tokenizers bpe-legacy,bpe-v3 --layer-exceptions embeddings --kernels aten,flash --kv-cache on,off --eval deid-code-rag --save ML-6233/logs
```

Tomas: nice. If a combo recovers fidelity we can either pin tokenizer or add a per-route runtime override for code-heavy endpoints. Also add an Optimize profile suggestion for 'code-int4' recommending embeddings fp16 + bpe-legacy.

anya: labeler instructions text to share in ops channel: "Confirm output reproduces the same tokens for identifiers and punctuation. If a token is split (e.g., calc_val -> calc_ val) mark identifier_split and include smallest evidence span. For hallucinations, mark hallucination and add short note. Escalate unmasked secrets to privacy-ops immediately."

ops-bot: LB-10021 populated with 450 candidates staged -> awaiting labeler assignment.

Tomas: console: add a dashboard card "code-token-preserve (deid-code-rag)" tracking exact-token-preserve on golden + prod slices and a regression alert if drop >2.5% week-over-week. Also export microgolden fingerprints for automatic diffing.

nora: starting the sweep now and will attach logs + kernel traces to ML-6233. If an obvious kernel/tokenizer combo fixes things we can ship a short-term runtime override while we investigate a permanent fix.

anya: thanks all. action items recap: (1) nora run tokenizer+kernel sweep + logs to ML-6233, (2) anya assemble + dedupe + populate LB-10021, (3) labelers start LB-10021, (4) tomas file console card + Optimize suggestion. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
